text:
I interviewed at a company in the anticipation of getting the B1 visa in a few weeks (interview appointment was scheduled). Everything went well and the company wanted me etc. But then PIBA cancelled our interview appointment the day before due to "staffing issues" and postponed it without giving us a new date 😭 Eventually we received a new appointment 7 weeks later than the original. Unfortunately the company wasn't able to wait so long for me and I missed out on the role :( 

It really depends on the company - it seemed that many don't really understand the partner visa process, and thought that there was a big chance that I could get rejected (even though this definitely wasn't the case - though the "delay" in me getting the visa really didn't help my credibility). Some companies may be unwilling to consider someone who doesn't have a work visa yet, whereas others might be happy to see how things go. Also depends on how long they are willing to keep the role open for you, and whether things will go smoothly with PIBA (often they do). But you can always try to just apply and see how things go.

Once I received the visa, I had to start looking again. Dozens of applications - many for jobs I thought I was very qualified for, but for which I received no response (felt like I was sending CVs into a void and honestly it was depressing at times), and a few interviews too.  It took around 4 months to finally get a role, but thankfully it was worth it - the job I eventually signed for is so awesome, and way better than what I would have been doing at the first company I interviewed with :)
